author: ivanlitteri
content:
Following up on our series about Ethereum’s post-quantum transition, we wrote about how to prepare Ethereum for Q-Day, or for an earlier AI-assisted breakthrough. We cover what it means for the protocol, users, applications, validators, and L2s to be ready for that day, and the path each of them can take to get there.

https://blog.lambdaclass.com/making-ethereum-ready-for-pqai-day/
